A '''fortress''' was built by the genetics terrorist [[Zeta Magnus]] atop the [[Canaitith Mountain]], the highest [[Mountain/Legends|peak]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Skye/Legends|Skye]]. Although Magnus was [[Battle of Skye|defeated]] by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|pupils]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Halagad Ventor]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], his fortress was later reused by [[Kharys]] when she became the [[Magister of Skye|Majestrix]] of Skye with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] blessing.

==History==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the first [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], a [[Zeta Magnus (clone)|clone]] of the [[Accelerated Transgenic Heuristic Abhorer|genetic abomination]] known as [[Zeta Magnus]] took control of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Skye/Legends|Skye]]. Using a mutagen, [[Gender/Legends|he]] transformed a third of Skye's natives, the [[S'kytri]], and made them his [[Zombie/Legends|zombie]]-like servants. Magnus subsequently ordered them to build him a fortress-keep atop [[Canaitith Mountain]], the highest [[Mountain/Legends|peak]] on the planet, where he would rule as the self-styled [[Magister of Skye]]. However, the Republic dispatched [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Halagad Ventor]], three members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], to [[Battle of Skye|intervene]]. The Jedi manged to infiltrate the fortress, and the clone of Magnus was eventually [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Ventor.<ref name="swcw" />

After the end of the Clone Wars, the Republic was replaced by an authoritarian [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. At some point during the Imperial period, Anakin Skywalker, now a malevolent [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] known as [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader, came back to Skye. He taught the ways of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] to [[Kharys]], a female S'kytri who had once helped him during the conflict with Magnus. By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the Empire bestowed the title of Majestrix to Kharys, who had claimed ownership of Magnus' old fortress. The Majestrix, however, was killed in an aerial duel with [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] that took place above that citadel.<ref name="TLH">[[Star Wars Annual (1977) 1|''Star Wars Annual'' (1977) 1]]</ref>

==Description==
The fortress-keep of Zeta Magnus stood atop Canaitith Mountain, and its foundation blended into the [[rock]] of the mountain itself. Built entirely from [[Gypryst|living bloodstone]], the fortress was a mishmash of architectural styles. Its rectangular main section was buttressed by two towers built in the style of the [[Serenno/Legends|Serennese]] [[Noble/Legends|aristocracy]]. A third tower, half again as tall as the others, rose from the primary section. Each tower was crowned by an organic-looking minaret similar to the hive spires of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. Together, the three towers seemed to emulate an irreverent finger gesture of [[Korun/Legends|Korunnai]] origin. Every side of the structure featured gaudy and impractical [[Window/Legends|windows]] in the modern [[Onderon/Legends|Onderonian]] style. The greatest of those windows ornamented the front and back of the middle section, giving it the shape of a double-ended [[Dagger/Legends|dagger]]. These windows were [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shielded]] and open balconies were defended by [[Automated defense system|automated defense turrets]].<ref name="swcw" /> 

In contrast to its outer appearance, the inside of the fortress was very austere, with most rooms and halls coated in reflective yet cold [[Ultrachrome/Legends|ultrachrome]]. Nonetheless, the citadel housed a laboratory built to look like a dungeon.<ref name="swcw" />
